## 1) Data Preparation

```{r}
path_v1 <- file.path("data", "validation1", "validation1.csv")
path_p1 <- file.path("data", "pilot1", "pilot1_full500data.csv")
path_p2 <- file.path("data", "pilot2", "pilot2_wave2.csv")

clean_validation1 <- function(path) {
  v1_raw <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |> slice(-c(1, 2))
  v1_clean <- v1_raw |>
    filter(Finished == "TRUE", QID2 == "I agree", QID6 == "Somewhat disagree") |>
    mutate(`Duration (in seconds)` = as.numeric(`Duration (in seconds)`))

  speed_threshold <- median(v1_clean$`Duration (in seconds)`, na.rm = TRUE) / 3

  v1 <- v1_clean |>
    filter(`Duration (in seconds)` >= speed_threshold) |>
    mutate(
      across(c(QID5_1, Q17_1, Q18_1, temp_c), as.numeric),
      worry_item = QID5_1,
      worry_index = (QID5_1 + Q17_1 + Q18_1) / 3,
      temp_numeric_c = temp_c,
      temp_centered_c = temp_c - mean(temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
      temp_condition = factor(temp_c),
      unit_condition = factor(unit, levels = c("C", "F"))
    ) |>
    select(worry_item, worry_index, temp_numeric_c, temp_centered_c, temp_condition, unit_condition,
           partyid, leaning, QID5_1, Q17_1, Q18_1) |>
    tidyr::drop_na(worry_item, worry_index, temp_numeric_c, temp_condition, unit_condition, QID5_1, Q17_1, Q18_1, partyid)

  list(v1 = v1, speed_threshold = speed_threshold)
}

clean_pilot1 <- function(path) {
  p1_raw <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |> slice(-c(1, 2))
  p1_raw |>
    filter(Finished == "TRUE", QID6 == "Somewhat disagree") |>
    transmute(
      worry = abs(parse_number(QID5)),
      temp_numeric = as.numeric(temp_c),
      temp_condition = factor(temp_c)
    ) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()
}

clean_pilot2 <- function(path) {
  p2_raw <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |> slice(-c(1, 2))
  p2_raw |>
    filter(Finished %in% c("TRUE", "True"), QID6 == "Somewhat disagree") |>
    transmute(
      worry = as.numeric(QID5_1),
      temp_numeric = as.numeric(temp_c),
      temp_condition = factor(temp_c)
    ) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()
}

v1_obj <- clean_validation1(path_v1)
v1 <- v1_obj$v1
p1 <- clean_pilot1(path_p1)
p2 <- clean_pilot2(path_p2)

alpha_cronbach <- function(mat) {
  k <- ncol(mat)
  item_vars <- apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_var <- var(rowSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (k <= 1 || total_var == 0) return(NA_real_)
  (k / (k - 1)) * (1 - sum(item_vars, na.rm = TRUE) / total_var)
}

alpha_worry <- alpha_cronbach(as.matrix(v1[, c("QID5_1", "Q17_1", "Q18_1")]))

pairwise_cohens_d <- function(data, outcome, group_var) {
  groups <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[group_var]])))
  pairs <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  d_rows <- lapply(pairs, function(g) {
    x1 <- data[[outcome]][as.character(data[[group_var]]) == g[1]]
    x2 <- data[[outcome]][as.character(data[[group_var]]) == g[2]]
    n1 <- sum(!is.na(x1))
    n2 <- sum(!is.na(x2))
    s1 <- sd(x1, na.rm = TRUE)
    s2 <- sd(x2, na.rm = TRUE)
    pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * s1^2 + (n2 - 1) * s2^2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
    d <- (mean(x1, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(x2, na.rm = TRUE)) / pooled_sd
    test <- t.test(x1, x2, var.equal = FALSE)
    tibble::tibble(
      group1 = g[1], group2 = g[2], n1 = n1, n2 = n2,
      statistic = unname(test$statistic), df = unname(test$parameter),
      p = test$p.value, cohen_d = d
    )
  })

  dplyr::bind_rows(d_rows)
}

kable(
  tibble::tibble(
    Dataset = c("Main study", "Pilot 1", "Pilot 2"),
    N = c(nrow(v1), nrow(p1), nrow(p2)),
    Outcome = c("Worry index (0-100)", "Worry (1-7)", "Worry (0-100)")
  ),
  caption = "Analytic sample sizes"
)

cat("Cronbach's alpha (Main study worry index):", round(alpha_worry, 3), "\n")
cat("Speeding exclusion threshold in main study (seconds):", round(v1_obj$speed_threshold, 2), "\n")
```

## 2) Main Paper Figure 1

```{r fig.height=9.5, fig.width=12}
m_index <- lm(worry_index ~ temp_numeric_c, data = v1)
m_p1 <- lm(worry ~ temp_numeric, data = p1)
m_p2 <- lm(worry ~ temp_numeric, data = p2)

model_caption <- function(model, digits = 3) {
  slope <- coef(model)[2]
  p_value <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4]
  r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
  paste0(
    "Coef = ", format(round(slope, digits), nsmall = digits),
    ", p = ", format.pval(p_value, digits = 3),
    ", R2 = ", format(round(r2, 3), nsmall = ifelse(r2 < 0.01, 3, 2))
  )
}

set.seed(123)
temp_breaks <- seq(1.5, 6, by = 0.5)
temp_labels <- as.character(temp_breaks)

paper_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "plain", size = 14),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "plain")
  )

plot_a <- ggplot(v1, aes(x = temp_numeric_c, y = worry_index)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.22, color = "gray45", size = 1.4) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
               geom = "pointrange", size = 0.9, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, aes(group = 1),
              color = "firebrick", fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.16) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = temp_breaks, labels = temp_labels) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  paper_theme +
  labs(
    title = "A", subtitle = paste0("Main Study (N = ", nrow(v1), ")"),
    x = "Projected Temperature Rise (C)", y = "Worry Index (0-100)",
    caption = model_caption(m_index)
  )

plot_b <- ggplot(p1, aes(x = temp_numeric, y = worry)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.22, color = "gray45", size = 1.4) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
               geom = "pointrange", size = 0.9, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, aes(group = 1),
              color = "firebrick", fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.16) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = temp_breaks, labels = temp_labels) +
  paper_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "B", subtitle = paste0("Pilot 1 (N = ", nrow(p1), ")"),
    x = "Projected Temperature Rise (C)", y = "Worry (1-7)",
    caption = model_caption(m_p1)
  )

plot_c <- ggplot(p2, aes(x = temp_numeric, y = worry)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.22, color = "gray45", size = 1.4) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
               geom = "pointrange", size = 0.9, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, aes(group = 1),
              color = "firebrick", fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.16) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = temp_breaks, labels = temp_labels) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  paper_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "C", subtitle = paste0("Pilot 2 (N = ", nrow(p2), ")"),
    x = "Projected Temperature Rise (C)", y = "Worry (0-100)",
    caption = model_caption(m_p2)
  )

# Figure 1D retains non-leaning Independents/Other as a third descriptive group
# (N=986), matching the main-paper figure.
party_three <- v1 |>
  mutate(
    party_figure = case_when(
      partyid == "Democrat" | leaning == "Closer to Democratic" ~ "Democrat",
      partyid == "Republican" | leaning == "Closer to Republican" ~ "Republican",
      TRUE ~ "Independent / Other"
    ),
    party_figure = factor(
      party_figure,
      levels = c("Democrat", "Republican", "Independent / Other")
    )
  )

# Tables 11 and 5 use two-party coding, including leaners (N=845).
party_binary_df <- v1 |>
  mutate(
    party_binary = case_when(
      partyid == "Democrat" ~ "Democrat",
      partyid == "Republican" ~ "Republican",
      partyid %in% c("Independent", "No preference", "Other party") &
        leaning == "Closer to Democratic" ~ "Democrat",
      partyid %in% c("Independent", "No preference", "Other party") &
        leaning == "Closer to Republican" ~ "Republican",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    party_binary = factor(party_binary, levels = c("Democrat", "Republican"))
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(party_binary)

plot_d <- ggplot(
  party_three,
  aes(x = temp_numeric_c, y = worry_index, color = party_figure, group = party_figure)
) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.08, size = 1.1) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
               geom = "pointrange", size = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = temp_breaks, labels = temp_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Democrat" = "#0072B2",
      "Republican" = "#D55E00",
      "Independent / Other" = "#999999"
    )
  ) +
  paper_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.71, 0.22),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray70"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10), legend.title = element_text(size = 11)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "D", subtitle = paste0("Main Study (N = ", nrow(party_three), ")"),
    x = "Projected Temperature Rise (C)", y = "Worry Index (0-100)", color = "Party"
  )

fig1 <- plot_a / (plot_b | plot_c | plot_d) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.05, 1))
fig1

dir.create(file.path("outputs", "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path("outputs", "figures", "Figure1.pdf"), fig1, width = 12, height = 9.5)
```

## 3) Study Chronology and Participant Flow

The public data exclude collection timestamps and direct participant identifiers.
The dates and exclusion counts below reproduce the participant-flow table in the
final SI.

```{r}
s1_flow <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Study, ~`Collection dates`, ~`Initial N`, ~`Did not consent`, ~`Failed attention check`, ~`Speeding exclusion`, ~`Final N`,
  "Pilot 1", "Sep. 22-23, 2025", 500, 1, 6, 0, 493,
  "Pilot 2", "Sep. 25-26, 2025", 504, 0, 6, 0, 498,
  "Main study", "Oct. 11-13, 2025", 1005, 1, 6, 12, 986
)

kable(s1_flow, caption = "Participant flow")
```

## 4) Main OLS

```{r}
s1_model <- lm(worry_index ~ temp_numeric_c, data = v1)
s1_tidy <- tidy(s1_model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  transmute(
    Predictor = dplyr::recode(term,
                              `(Intercept)` = "(Intercept)",
                              temp_numeric_c = "Projected warming (C)"),
    Coefficient = round(estimate, 3),
    `Std. Error` = round(std.error, 3),
    `95% CI` = paste0("[", round(conf.low, 2), ", ", round(conf.high, 2), "]"),
    `p-value` = signif(p.value, 3)
  )

s1_fit <- glance(s1_model)

kable(s1_tidy, caption = "Table 1. Linear regression model predicting worry index")
kable(
  tibble::tibble(
    N = nrow(v1),
    `R-squared` = round(s1_fit$r.squared, 3),
    `Adjusted R-squared` = round(s1_fit$adj.r.squared, 3)
  ),
  caption = "Table 1 model fit"
)
```

## 5) Holm-Corrected Pairwise Comparisons

```{r}
cohen_d_pairs <- pairwise_cohens_d(v1, "worry_index", "temp_condition")

s2_pairs <- cohen_d_pairs |>
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p, method = "holm")) |>
  transmute(
    Group1 = group1, Group2 = group2, N1 = n1, N2 = n2,
    t = statistic, df = df, p = p, p_adj = p.adj,
    `Cohen's d` = cohen_d
  )

kable(s2_pairs |> select(-`Cohen's d`), digits = 4, caption = "Table 2. Pairwise contrasts across warming conditions with Holm correction")
```

## 6) Unit Framing Interaction

```{r}
s3_model <- lm(worry_index ~ temp_centered_c * unit_condition, data = v1)
s3_tidy <- tidy(s3_model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  transmute(
    Predictor = dplyr::recode(term,
                              `(Intercept)` = "(Intercept)",
                              temp_centered_c = "Projected warming (centered at 3.699 C)",
                              unit_conditionF = "Unit condition [Fahrenheit]",
                              `temp_centered_c:unit_conditionF` = "Warming x Unit [Fahrenheit]"),
    Coefficient = round(estimate, 3),
    `Std. Error` = round(std.error, 3),
    `95% CI` = paste0("[", round(conf.low, 2), ", ", round(conf.high, 2), "]"),
    `p-value` = signif(p.value, 3)
  )

s3_fit <- glance(s3_model)

kable(s3_tidy, caption = "Table 3. Interaction model: warming x unit framing")
kable(
  tibble::tibble(
    N = nrow(v1),
    `R-squared` = round(s3_fit$r.squared, 3),
    `Adjusted R-squared` = round(s3_fit$adj.r.squared, 3)
  ),
  caption = "Table 3 model fit"
)
```

## 8) Party x Temperature Model

The interaction term for projected warming by party is not statistically significant (`p = 0.938` for Republican vs Democrat slope difference), indicating little evidence that warming sensitivity differs by party.

```{r}
s5_interaction_model <- lm(worry_index ~ temp_numeric_c * party_binary, data = party_binary_df)

s5_interaction <- tidy(s5_interaction_model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  transmute(
    Term = term,
    Coefficient = round(estimate, 3),
    `Std. Error` = round(std.error, 3),
    `95% CI` = paste0("[", round(conf.low, 2), ", ", round(conf.high, 2), "]"),
    `p-value` = signif(p.value, 3)
  )

s5_fit <- glance(s5_interaction_model)

kable(s5_interaction, caption = "Table 5. Interaction model for party-specific sensitivity to projected warming")
kable(
  tibble::tibble(
    N = nrow(party_binary_df),
    `R-squared` = round(s5_fit$r.squared, 3),
    `Adjusted R-squared` = round(s5_fit$adj.r.squared, 3)
  ),
  caption = "Table 5 model fit"
)
```

```{r}

  transmute(
    Predictor = dplyr::recode(term, `(Intercept)` = "(Intercept)", temp_numeric = "Projected warming (C)"),
```

## 11) Item-Level Regressions

Each main-study item is regressed separately on assigned warming. Pilot regressions
report the single worry item collected in each pilot.

```{r, results="asis"}
s8_fit <- lm(QID5_1 ~ temp_numeric_c, data = v1)
s9_fit <- lm(Q17_1 ~ temp_numeric_c, data = v1)
s10_fit <- lm(Q18_1 ~ temp_numeric_c, data = v1)
for (entry in list(list(s8_fit, "8. Worry assigned temperature"),
                   list(s9_fit, "9. Harm to US people"),
                   list(s10_fit, "10. Personal harm"))) {
  print(kable(tidy(entry[[1]], conf.int = TRUE), digits = 3,
              caption = paste("Table", entry[[2]])))
  print(kable(glance(entry[[1]]) |> select(nobs, r.squared, adj.r.squared),
              digits = 3, caption = paste("Model fit:", entry[[2]])))
}
```

## 12) Within-Party Regressions

```{r}
s11_models <- party_binary_df |>
  group_by(party_binary) |>
  group_map(~ lm(worry_index ~ temp_numeric_c, data = .x), .keep = TRUE)
names(s11_models) <- levels(party_binary_df$party_binary)

s11 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(s11_models), function(group_name) {
  model <- s11_models[[group_name]]
  slope <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |> filter(term == "temp_numeric_c")
  intercept <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |> filter(term == "(Intercept)")
  fit <- glance(model)
  tibble(
    Party = group_name,
    N = nobs(model),
    Intercept = intercept$estimate,
    `Intercept SE` = intercept$std.error,
    `Intercept t` = intercept$statistic,
    `Intercept p` = intercept$p.value,
    `Intercept CI low` = intercept$conf.low,
    `Intercept CI high` = intercept$conf.high,
    `Projected warming` = slope$estimate,
    `Projected warming SE` = slope$std.error,
    `Projected warming t` = slope$statistic,
    `Projected warming CI low` = slope$conf.low,
    `Projected warming CI high` = slope$conf.high,
    `p-value` = slope$p.value,
    `R-squared` = fit$r.squared,
    `Adjusted R-squared` = fit$adj.r.squared
  )
}))

kable(
  s11 |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  caption = "Table 11. Within-party linear regressions of worry index on projected warming"
)
```

## 14) Machine-Readable Output Tables

The CSV files below contain the analysis results. Their numbering is mapped to
the statistical PDF tables in `extended_analysis/README.md`.

```{r}
dir.create(file.path("outputs", "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_export <- function(model) {
  fit <- glance(model)
  tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
      N = nobs(model),
      R_squared = fit$r.squared,
      adjusted_R_squared = fit$adj.r.squared
    )
}

write_csv(s1_flow, file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s1.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(s1_model), file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s2.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(m_p1), file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s3.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(m_p2), file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s4.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(s8_fit), file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s5.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(s9_fit), file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s6.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(s10_fit), file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s7.csv"))
write_csv(s2_pairs, file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s8.csv"))
write_csv(s11, file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s9.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(s5_interaction_model), file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s10.csv"))
write_csv(model_export(s3_model) |> mutate(centering_value = mean(v1$temp_numeric_c)),
          file.path("outputs", "tables", "table_s11.csv"))
# table_s12.csv is generated by text_embedding/run_text_embedding.py;
# table_s13.csv contains archived aggregate sensitivity results.

kable(
  tibble(
    Output = c("Participant flow", "1", "6", "7", "8", "9", "10",
               "2", "11", "5", "3", "4", "12"),
    File = file.path("outputs", "tables", paste0("table_s", 1:13, ".csv"))
  ),
  caption = "Machine-readable SI table outputs"
)
```
